description: This is a PHP source file defining a MessageListener class within a project. The class handles various message-related events such as creation and deletion, sending emails, and updating feeds related to project messaging and support interactions.

classes.name: MessageListener
classes.description: A class that listens to message events such as creation and deletion, and performs actions like sending emails and creating feed entries related to project messages and support interactions.

methods.name: onMessageCreated
methods.description: Handles actions to be taken when a new message is created, including creating feed entries and sending relevant emails based on message type.

methods.name: onMessageDeleted
methods.description: Handles cleanup or updates when a message is deleted, such as updating messenger counts.

methods.name: sendMail
methods.description: Internal method responsible for constructing and sending email notifications to recipients based on message details and templates.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to, currently message creation and deletion.
